Sara — thanks for the clear ask and for the VAT doc attached. Short answer: we can probably accommodate a temporary extension with a few guardrails. Proposed approach: 

- Temporary terms: Net60 for invoices dated within the pilot (first 90 days).
- Credit cap: EUR 120,000 ceiling while on Net60.
- Payment security: first invoice for onboarding (estimated ~EUR 18k) to be paid Net30. Remaining pilot invoices on Net60.
- Documentation: we need a signed PO, a completed credit application (see attached), and the VAT registration copy (you already sent).
- Finance ask: Redwood Finance to run a light credit check and countersign the temporary terms; if any late payments occur we reserve the right to suspend Net60 and require Net30 with a deposit.

If that works I’ll loop in Marcus to run the credit app and finalize. Can you confirm the PO amount and whether Medilink can provide an ACH/SEPA remit instruction?

Best,

Sara — welcome, and thank you for the quick turnaround on paperwork. I’m the head of Revenue Operations and I’ll greenlight a controlled path forward. Summary of what Redwood will do now: 

- Temporary approval: Redwood approves Net60 for pilot invoices up to a EUR 120,000 cap for 90 days beginning on date of first pilot invoice (exceptions require written escalation).
- Immediate step: Because we received the PO for EUR 95,000 and the completed credit application, Finance will provision the limit immediately and Marcus will countersign the credit addendum.
- Payment sequencing: First invoice (onboarding) remains Net30 to align our delivery calendar; subsequent pilot invoices may be Net60 while under the cap.
- VAT: We accept the supplied VAT reg doc — please confirm whether Medilink expects reverse charge (we will include the reverse‑charge note on invoice if requested).
- Remit: We will accept SEPA to the IBAN provided; confirm payer details on the PO to avoid routing delays.

We’ll issue a short credit addendum for signature (one page) and countersign on receipt of the completed credit app + bank reference. If all clears, you should see the first invoice issued next week and finance will track to ensure timely payment.

I’ll monitor this personally while the pilot is active — if anything slips we’ll revert to Net30 with a deposit requirement. Looking forward to a smooth kickoff.
